description: This file defines the InterestPeriod class, which models a period of interest calculation within a loan repayment schedule. It includes fields for dates, amounts, rate factors, and methods for manipulating and calculating interest-related data. The class also provides copying, initialization, and utility functions relevant to interest periods in loan processing.

classes.name: InterestPeriod
classes.description: Represents a specific period of interest accrual and calculation within a loan repayment schedule, encapsulating relevant data and methods for interest computations, adjustments, and state management.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of an InterestPeriod with the same properties, given a repayment period and math context.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty InterestPeriod with null dates and amounts for a given repayment period and math context.

methods.name: withEmptyAmounts
methods.description: Creates an InterestPeriod with zero amounts and specified dates, optionally marked as paused.

methods.name: withPausedAndEmptyAmounts
methods.description: Creates a paused InterestPeriod with zero amounts and specified dates.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this InterestPeriod to another based on due dates.

methods.name: addBalanceCorrectionAmount
methods.description: Adds an amount to the balance correction component.

methods.name: addDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Adds an amount to the disbursement total.

methods.name: addCreditedPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds an amount to credited principal.

methods.name: addCreditedInterestAmount
methods.description: Adds an amount to credited interest.

methods.name: addCapitalizedIncomePrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds an amount to capitalized income principal.

methods.name: getCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Calculates the due interest for the period, considering if the period is paused, and based on interest method and period length.

methods.name: getCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on method and period length.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the interest period in days.

methods.name: getLengthTillPeriodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the number of days from fromDate to the period's due date.

methods.name: updateOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Updates the outstanding loan balance based on previous interest periods and disbursements.

methods.name: getCreditedAmounts
methods.description: Returns the total credited amounts including disbursement, principal, and capitalized income.

methods.name: isFirstInterestPeriod
methods.description: Checks if this is the first interest period in the repayment schedule.

methods.name: getCreditedPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the credited principal, or zero if null.

methods.name: getCreditedInterest
methods.description: Returns the credited interest, or zero if null.

methods.name: getDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Returns the disbursement amount, or zero if null.

methods.name: getBalanceCorrectionAmount
methods.description: Returns the balance correction amount, or zero if null.

methods.name: getOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Returns the outstanding loan balance, or zero if null.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomePrincipal
methods.description: Returns the capitalized income principal, or zero if null.

methods.name: getRateFactor
methods.description: Returns the rate factor, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getRateFactorTillPeriodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the rate factor till period due date, defaulting to zero if null.
